scope: Make tool activity easier to scan
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--failed-tool-details-compac.task: See tool title, result and duration together with complete details on demand.
conversation--failed-tool-details-compac.observations: The opened failed check retains its title, Failed badge, 2.4 s duration, readable result and copy actions. The compact layout keeps the markers beside their rows without crowding the main controls. Connector endpoints align; there are no crossings or detached branches. Dark statuses and text are readable.
